sources.title: Chatterbox-Multilingual-pt-br | AxForge
sources.snippet: Chatterbox-Multilingual-pt-br is a text-to-speech model developed by ResembleAI that is optimized for Brazilian Portuguese. It is a single-language finetune from the Chatterbox Multilingual V3 pack designed for expressive speech generation and voice cloning.
